summary: Lincoln County, MT Kootenai NF tower built 1941 with L-4 cab, destroyed 1958; no source describes the site today.

evidence.supports: listed as tower, gone, at 48.95900 north 115.76937 west
Roswell Ridge named in a Lincoln County list
Roswell Ridge legal location 37N-32W-21 in the Kootenai National Forest, no history given

notes_for_editor: Thin record: only firelookout.com and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list describe this lookout, and they agree on the 1941 tower, the 1958 destruction and the gone status. The Forest Lookouts Lincoln County list names a Roswell Ridge in the Kootenai National Forest at 37N-32W-21 with no history; whether it is this lookout is unconfirmed, and the story says so. Staffing, fires, access and any present-day remains are not in any source found. Two searches found nothing more. No photo found.
